topic.title: Leap Year Check
topic.description: Determines whether a year is a leap year using divisibility rules: divisible by 4, not by 100, unless also by 400. Teaches compound boolean expressions.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Combining and/or logical operators in a single condition and applying the real-world leap year rule.
learningNotes.challenges: Getting the order of conditions correct — 400 must be checked before 100.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Validate non-integer input and build a date library.

files.description: Leap year checker with compound boolean logic.
